page.overview:
What is Umbreon?

Umbreon is a quadrupedal, mammalian feliform Pokémon that resembles a black cat with some lagomorph traits. Umbreon has mainly sleek black fur with luminescent yellow rings encircling its ears and tail and round yellow circular patterns on its forehead and on each of its legs. Its physical characteristics resemble both a feline and canine, with a short muzzle and a small triangular nose, but its large ears are reminiscent to a hare or a rabbit. It has red eyes, and unlike the rest of the Eeveelutions they also have visible black-colored oval-shaped pupils that often appear slit, as well as patches of black fur of a darker shade around its eyes. Umbreon has a slightly bushy black tail with a single yellow ring encircling its thickest part; the tail thins out at the tip. Umbreon has small sharp fangs, and can be seen when it opens its mouth, similar to Sylveon. Compared to its counterparts, Umbreon is significantly different from Eevee in general appearance, as it resembles its pre-evolution the least. It is usually the result of Eevee having a strong friendship with its Trainer during the nighttime.

A Shiny Umbreon has blue ring markings, its fur is a deep shade of gray rather than black, and its eyes are bright yellow like a black cat's.

Like other Eeveelutions, Umbreon are carnivorous Pokémon, known as solitary predators, and will stalk prey silently during the night. When an Umbreon senses an enemy's presence, it waits for its enemy to come into range. It kills its prey by pouncing, then biting its throat with its small, sharp fangs before eating it. Normally, Umbreon have a quiet but gentle personality.

Once tamed, they are very protective of their Trainers similarly to Espeon and will chase aggressors with Pursuit.
